entities.quote: This document prescribes the requirement for the safety of electrical equipment designation for used with input voltage rating between 50 and 1000 volts for alternating current and between 75 volts to 1500 volts for direct current. The electrical equipment under this scope is called “Low Voltage Equipment.”
